messages:
Sam B.: @channel getting a PagerDuty for billing/overage-alerts. Multiple accounts show sudden overage flags starting ~1778889950. Token counts spiking 10-30x for short windows. Opening thread to triage.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • billing-metering • sev2 • initiated by PagerDuty • link: https://pager.example/INC-12345

Priya: copying in Billing-Eng and Support-SRE. Do we have any known deploys in the last 30m?

Devon: I see a canary deploy to edge-proxy 3m before spike. No model/serving changes. Quick check: proxy logs show a lot of 502 -> client retries. Suspect retry storms causing duplicate token emission into the metering pipeline.

Maya: @Devon can you paste the relevant proxy log snippet?

Devon: sure, from proxy-instance-07: ```
[2026-05-14T18:12:31Z] request_id=abc123 upstream=503 retry=1 account=acct_42 tokens=152
[2026-05-14T18:12:33Z] request_id=abc123 upstream=200 retry=2 account=acct_42 tokens=150
[2026-05-14T18:12:34Z] request_id=abc123 forwarded=true
```

Devon: note the same request_id retried and then forwarded, and our metering emitter doesn't de-dup on request_id at that stage. That will inflate token counts when retries occur and the emitter re-emits after a success.

Billing-Eng: confirmed. The metering pipeline dedup key is currently `emitter_id + sequence` and the proxy retries are changing the sequence. We recently removed request_id from the dedup window to reduce latency. Rolling that change back would reintroduce a small latency bump but fix duplicate emits.

Sam B.: Customer impact? Which accounts saw false overages?

Support-SRE: preliminary list from alerts: acct_42, acct_98, acct_enterprise_beta, ~120 sandbox accounts. Looks like low-volume accounts flagged because their short bursts passed the overage threshold. No major enterprise billing spikes yet but we should assume noise.

Priya: Mitigation plan (proposed): 1) Revert edge-proxy canary to last stable (Devon) 2) Pause metering emitter downstream dedupe change via feature-flag (Billing-Eng) 3) Run backfill to correct inflated token counts for customers flagged (Support-SRE + Billing-Eng) 4) Post a customer outreach note and queue refunds where appropriate. Anyone object?

Devon: I can rollback the proxy canary now. Executing: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=214` — will update in ~60s.

ops-bot: deploy/edge-proxy revert started by Devon. Rollout ID: r-20260514-998.

Billing-Eng: toggled `metering_dedupe_v2` feature-flag -> OFF in production (ops change id ff-633). This prevents the change from emitting dedup-key variance.

Maya: After revert and flag toggle we should see emitter traffic normalizing. I'll watch the aggregate token rate.

Sam B.: Support-SRE, can you start a scoped backfill for the flagged accounts and mark any billing adjustments as provisional until we've verified final counts? Use the safe backfill job `metering-backfill --time-window 1778889800-1778889999 --accounts acct_42,acct_98,acct_enterprise_beta` and run in dry-run first.

Support-SRE: starting dry-run backfill now. Dry-run shows corrected counts reduce flagged accounts from 123 -> 4. Job id: bf-20260514-77 (dry). Will promote to write after verification.

Billing-Eng: we'll prepare a list of potential refunds and a short customer note. ETA for write backfill + refund list ~45m if rollback holds.

Priya: Communication: draft a short line for support channel and a longer postmortem stub. Sam, do you want to lead the customer note?

Sam B.: Yep, I'll draft the customer-facing message and share in #support after we confirm backfill results. Also tagging @incident-bot to record timeline.

incident-bot: UPDATE • rollback complete • ff-633 OFF • backfill dry-run complete (reduces flagged from 123->4) • continuing to monitor • runbook: https://confluence.example/incidents/metering-retry-dedup

Devon: Observability note — adding a short-term alert: metering.emit_rate > baseline * 5 && retry_ratio > 0.1 to catch similar events. Pushing rule in 2m.

ops-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-12345 acknowledged by Sam B. Handoff planned to morning oncall if still open.

Sam B.: Closing loop for now — revert fixed the immediate spike, feature-flag prevented further duplication, backfill dry-run looks promising. Will escalate to postmortem with root cause: proxy retry behavior + dedupe key change. Assigning owners: Postmortem (Priya), Billing reconciliation (Billing-Eng), Fix in emitter (Devon).

Support-SRE: marking incident as recovering. Will update when backfill write completes.

Maya: quick note — check CDN and any client SDKs that might be double-retrying on 502s; worth a short compatibility doc.

Sam B.: Thanks everyone — great quick triage. :thumbsup:
